        const rabbits = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, parseInt(document.getElementById("rcRabbits").value, 10) || 1));
        const unit = document.getElementById("rcUnit").value;
        const lengthM = toMetres(document.getElementById("rcLength").value, unit);
        const widthM = toMetres(document.getElementById("rcWidth").value, unit);
        const heightM = toMetres(document.getElementById("rcHeight").value, unit);
        const rabbitSize = document.getElementById("rcRabbitSize").value;
        const setup = getChecked("setup");
        const access = getChecked("access");

        const area = lengthM * widthM;
        const target = calculateTarget(rabbits, rabbitSize);
        const percent = target > 0 ? Math.round((area / target) * 100) : 0;
        const safePercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));

        areaM.textContent = fmt(area, " m²");
        targetM.textContent = fmt(target, " m²");
        areaPercent.textContent = percent + "% of target";
        progressBar.style.width = safePercent + "%";

        let status = "bad";
        let title = "This setup looks too small.";
        let text = "Try to increase the usable floor space before relying on accessories or short play sessions.";
        let advice = [];

        if (!area || !heightM) {
          status = "warn";
          title = "Add your measurements to check the setup.";
          text = "Enter the usable length, width and height of the space your rabbits can access.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Measure inside:</strong> Use the usable internal space, not the outer footprint.",
            "<strong>Linked areas:</strong> Only count areas your rabbits can freely access."
          ];
        } else if (area >= target && heightM >= 1 && access === "always") {
          status = "good";
          title = "This setup looks generous against the calculator target.";
          text = "Your measurements meet or exceed the suggested floor space and height target. Keep focusing on safety, flooring, enrichment and daily checks.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Great space:</strong> Add hiding places, tunnels, hay areas and enrichment without crowding the floor.",
            "<strong>Keep checking:</strong> Watch behaviour, appetite, droppings and signs of boredom.",
            "<strong>Safety:</strong> Make sure flooring is non-slip and the setup is secure."
          ];
        } else if (area >= target && heightM >= 1) {
          status = "warn";
          title = "The size looks good, but access may be the issue.";
          text = "Your space meets the suggested size target, but rabbits benefit most when the full area is available all the time.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Access:</strong> Try to make the run or pen permanently available if safe to do so.",
            "<strong>Routine:</strong> Short exercise sessions are helpful, but they should not replace a roomy home base.",
            "<strong>Safety:</strong> Check doors, panels, flooring and predator protection."
          ];
        } else if (area >= target * 0.75) {
          status = "warn";
          title = "This setup is close, but could be improved.";
          text = "Your enclosure is near the suggested target, but extra space would give your rabbits more room for movement and enrichment.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Add space:</strong> Consider adding a permanent run, larger pen or rabbit-proofed room access.",
            "<strong>Reduce clutter:</strong> Keep accessories useful but avoid filling too much floor space.",
            "<strong>Height check:</strong> Make sure rabbits can stand upright without touching the roof."
          ];
        } else {
          status = "bad";
          title = "This setup is likely too small.";
          text = "The usable floor space is below the calculator target. Rabbits need room to hop, stretch, run, hide and explore every day.";
          advice = [
            "<strong>Upgrade first:</strong> Increase the main living space before adding more toys or accessories.",
            "<strong>Permanent run:</strong> A secure attached run or larger pen can make a big difference.",
            "<strong>Avoid hutch-only living:</strong> A hutch alone is not enough as a rabbit's main home."
          ];
        }

        if (heightM > 0 && heightM < 1) {
          status = status === "good" ? "warn" : status;
          advice.push("<strong>Height:</strong> Aim for at least 1m so rabbits can stand upright and move comfortably.");
        }

        if (setup === "outdoor") {
          advice.push("<strong>Outdoor safety:</strong> Check predator protection, shade, weatherproofing, locks and flooring.");
        }

        if (setup === "free-roam") {
          advice.push("<strong>Free roam:</strong> Rabbit-proof wires, unsafe plants, furniture gaps and slippery floors.");
        }

        if (rabbits >= 3) {
          advice.push("<strong>Group housing:</strong> Larger groups need extra space so rabbits can move away from each other.");
        }

        statusBadge.className = "rccage-result-badge " + status;
        statusBadge.textContent = status === "good" ? "Looks good" : status === "warn" ? "Could improve" : "Needs more space";
        resultTitle.textContent = title;
        resultText.textContent = text;

        adviceList.innerHTML = advice.map(function (item) {
          return "<li>" + item + "</li>";
        }).join("");
      }

      form.addEventListener("submit", updateResult);
